title: P0 bounded continuation — refresh existing PR against current main
body:
Parent: #701
Existing implementation PR: #947
Continuous-improvement ledger: #948

## Definition of done
The existing PR is refreshed against current main and left mergeable for operator review. Ordinary reversible docs/config work only.

## Constraints
No schema, env/secrets, external messaging, payment, production deploy, second CRM/database, or scope expansion.
notes: Reproduction for #962: list-form 'No …, production deploy' must not infer protectedGate production. Synthetic wording; no secrets or private client data.
